About these figures

  • Figures come from the borough's monthly financial reports to Borough Council (59 reports, June 2021 to October 2026). Each report gives every account's budget and its total for the year to date, so a year's actual is the total in its December report. These are the borough's books as reported each month, before the year's audit.
  • The budget is the one in the same reports, so actuals and budget are counted the same way. It can include changes made during the year, and it is split into categories a little differently from the adopted budgets on the overview.
  • Every account in the reports was assigned by hand to one of the overview's categories. Employee benefits, which the borough budgets and pays centrally, are shared out in proportion to each category's salaries, and the Sewer & Solid Waste Fund's administration is split between sewer and solid waste; figures that include such a share are marked * and are estimates. Category totals are exact.
  • Transfers between the borough's own funds are left out ($196,000 was booked as one in May 2026 and reversed in June).
  • The reports are scanned images, read with OCR software. Every figure was checked against the reports' own subtotals and percentages and against the other reports that print it, and misread figures were corrected (marked †). A few figures could not be confirmed (marked ?). Where a line was misread beyond correction, its department's printed subtotal is used, and the difference is shown as "not matched to a line". Every month's totals agree with the totals printed on the report's cover to within $10, except where the cover itself is wrong.
  • No usable report is posted for March 2024, November 2024, May 2025, July 2025, October 2025 and January 2026 (some months' reports contain only the bills list). Where a month's own report is missing, its year-to-date figures are taken from the same month's report a year later, which repeats them as the previous year's.

Data, code, and the full method: https://github.com/diego519/Swarthmore-budget. This is an independent project, not affiliated with Swarthmore Borough; the borough's documents are the authoritative source.

This site uses Google Analytics to follow usage trends: how many people visit, and which of its features they use. No data is collected for commercial purposes.
